name: P9: Python boolean operator wrap inside dict()
input: config = dict(RedirBuilderSendNonBaobabClicks=is_images_click_log or is_video_click_log or is_baobab_click_log, Other=1)
expected:
config = dict(
    RedirBuilderSendNonBaobabClicks=is_images_click_log
        or is_video_click_log
        or is_baobab_click_log,
    Other=1,
)
note: LOGS-5799 problem 9 (open): 'or' lands at the start of the next line at the same level as keys. https://st.yandex-team.ru/LOGS-5799
